mapper.select: SELECT id, uid, title, content, message_type, ref_id, is_read, create_time FROM message_center WHERE uid = #{uid} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_center (uid, title, content, message_type, ref_id, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{uid}, #{title}, #{content}, #{messageType}, #{refId}, #{isRead}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM message_center WHERE id = #{id} AND uid = #{uid}
